inputs.text: ABU DHABI, 22nd August, 2026 (WAM) -- The National Centre of Meteorology (NCM) issued an alert over the possibility of convective cloud formation accompanied by light to moderate rainfall, which may become heavy at times. The alert is in effect from 13:30 on Saturday until 21:00 the same day. The NCM said the weather conditions are expected to affect some eastern, southern and western areas, extending to parts of the country's interior.

requested_area.areaDesc: Eastern, southern and western areas (demo zone)

fields.description: NCM alert: convective clouds with light to moderate rain, possibly heavy at times, in some eastern, southern and western areas and parts of the interior. In effect Saturday 22 Aug 2026, 13:30 to 21:00.
fields.headline: NCM alert: rain, heavy at times, possible in eastern, southern and western areas
fields.instruction: Take extra care when driving in rain and avoid standing water. Follow updates at https://alerts.example.ae.
fields.note_for_reviewer: I set severity to Moderate and certainty to Possible because NCM describes light to moderate rain that may become heavy at times, and the source gives no time zone for 13:30–21:00. Please also check that the instruction, which is generic rain-safety advice not taken from the NCM text, fits your standard wording.

payload.summary: The alert matches the verified NCM bulletin. The hazard is the same: convective clouds with light to moderate rain, possibly heavy at times. The time window is the same: Saturday 22 Aug 2026, 13:30 to 21:00, and 22 Aug 2026 is a Saturday. The areas are the same: eastern, southern and western areas plus parts of the interior, given in full in the description. Certainty 'Possible' fits the bulletin's 'possibility of' wording. Severity 'Moderate' does not overstate light to moderate rain that is only occasionally heavy. The alert contains no unverified reports.
